findings.title: Visual goal highlight can be mistaken for a tolerance boundary

evidence.meaning: The active goal ring is decorative emphasis, so the completed controlled point lies outside it despite tolerance satisfaction.

findings.recommendation: Clarify in notes that the ring only highlights the active target, or replace the ring with a non-boundary emphasis. If using a tolerance circle, verify the historical intermediate threshold before assigning geometric meaning.
findings.resolution: Removed target circle and disk from all staged figures; active target is now a larger saturated star. Actual endpoint keeps its small colored outline. Geometry transforms and PDF sizes remain unchanged.
